output.revised_prompt:
Create a production-ready large nine-slice-safe UI panel frame for a premium portrait mobile casino game. One original symmetrical wide rounded-rectangular ornamental frame designed specifically for large headers, rules panels, and payout modals—clearly a true display surround, never a small button enlarged.

Exact front orthographic view, perfect bilateral symmetry, 3:2 landscape canvas. The frame occupies approximately 88% of canvas width and 78% of canvas height, with generous exterior padding. The central aperture is extremely large, completely unobstructed, and filled only by the background blue. Keep all four corners compact. Top, bottom, left, and right rails must each have long, quiet, perfectly straight, visually uniform repeatable sections suitable for nine-slice scaling.

Frame design: thin layered rails of brushed pale champagne gold and warm ivory enamel; subtle soft rose-gold details; restrained blank embossed coin medallions integrated at the four corners with no symbols or markings; small luminous nacreous pearl rivets; tiny restrained ruby and muted emerald pin-light accents; a narrow warm burgundy enamel inner lip. Decorations remain strictly confined to thin rails and compact corners. Refined, inviting, prosperous, softly festive casino luxury rather than royal, solemn, or baroque.

Photorealistic high-end 3D commercial mobile game UI asset. Realistic polished and brushed metal, smooth ivory enamel, nacreous pearls, blank embossed coins, and tiny cut gemstones. Warm soft casino studio lighting with believable controlled metal edge highlights, delicate pearl luminosity, and restrained gemstone glints. Clean hard silhouette.

Background requirements are critical: one perfectly flat, uniform electric blue chroma key background, exact solid #0000FF, edge to edge, visible outside the frame and through the entire central aperture. Absolutely no texture, gradient, vignette, horizon, ambient variation, cast shadow, reflection, bloom, halo, or glow touching the blue background. No blue anywhere on the frame itself.

Strict exclusions: no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, currency symbols, iconography, or inscriptions; no objects or decoration in the center aperture; no tall twisted columns, palace arch, oversized crown, crest, wings, dominant gemstones, repeated giant corner gems, button-like proportions, thick yellow outline, black or red drop shadow, dark severe mood, scenery, characters, or clutter. Crisp isolated game asset, production large-panel proportions, elegant and restrained.
